cards.ex: It's tough to make ends meet when you're only working part-time.
cards.exUz: Yarim stavkada ishlaganingizda ro'zg'orni tebratish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Daromadni xarajat bilan tenglashtirish, qiyinchilik bilan pul topish.

cards.ex: They were dirt poor growing up, but they worked hard to get ahead.
cards.exUz: Ular o'sib ulg'ayganlarida ocharchilikda edilar, lekin oldinga siljish uchun qattiq mehnat qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda kambag'al, hech qanday puli yo'q.

cards.ex: His family is quite well-off, so he doesn't have to worry about money.
cards.exUz: Uning oilasi ancha boy, shuning uchun u pul haqida qayg'urishi shart emas.

cards.ex: Many people are living paycheck to paycheck these days with rising costs.
cards.exUz: Hozirgi kunda ko'plab odamlar narxlar oshishi bilan oylikdan oylikkacha yashashadi.
cards.uzDef: Pulni topish va sarflash faqat oylik maoshdan maoshgacha bo'lgan vaqt oralig'ida.

cards.ex: We need to tighten our belts and cut back on unnecessary spending.
cards.exUz: Biz kamarimizni bog'lashimiz va keraksiz xarajatlarni qisqartirishimiz kerak.

cards.ex: I heard he's loaded; he bought a new sports car.
cards.exUz: Eshitishimcha, u juda boy; u yangi sport mashinasini sotib oldi.

cards.ex: Many small businesses are struggling during the economic downturn.
cards.exUz: Ko'plab kichik bizneslar iqtisodiy tanazzul davrida qiynalmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchilik bilan pul topish, moliyaviy muammolarga duch kelmoq.

cards.ex: He made a killing on the stock market last year.
cards.exUz: U o'tgan yili fond bozorida katta foyda ko'rdi.
cards.uzDef: Tez va osonlik bilan juda ko'p pul topmoq.

cards.ex: They're just scraping by on her small pension.
cards.exUz: Ular uning kichik pensiyasi bilan zo'rg'a yetkazishmoqda.

cards.ex: The company has been in the red for the last two quarters.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya oxirgi ikki chorak davomida qarzdor bo'lib kelmoqda.

cards.ex: After a tough year, the business is finally in the black.
cards.exUz: Og'ir yildan so'ng, biznes nihoyat foydada.

cards.ex: That new car cost an arm and a leg!
cards.exUz: Bu yangi mashina juda qimmatga tushdi!
cards.term: cost an arm and a leg

cards.ex: Millions of people live below the poverty line.
cards.exUz: Millionlab odamlar qashshoqlik chegarasidan pastda yashaydilar.
cards.uzDef: Minimal daromad darajasi, undan pastda qashshoqlik hisoblanadi.

cards.ex: He thought he could make easy money gambling, but he lost everything.
cards.exUz: U qimor o'ynab oson pul topish mumkin deb o'yladi, lekin hamma narsasini yo'qotdi.
cards.uzDef: Tez va oz mehnat bilan topilgan pul.

cards.ex: She's been building up a nest egg for her retirement.
cards.exUz: U nafaqaga chiqishi uchun tejamkorlik qilib kelmoqda.

cards.ex: The hospital is cash-strapped and needs more funding.
cards.exUz: Kasalxona pulga muhtoj va ko'proq mablag'ga muhtoj.

cards.ex: After winning the lottery, they started living high on the hog.
cards.exUz: Lotereyada yutgandan so'ng, ular dabdabali hayot kechira boshladilar.

cards.ex: He was down and out for a while after losing his job.
cards.exUz: U ishini yo'qotgandan so'ng bir muddat qashshoq ahvolda edi.

cards.ex: He made a fortune in the tech industry.
cards.exUz: U texnologiya sohasida boylik orttirdi.

cards.ex: Many families are on the breadline due to unemployment.
cards.exUz: Ko'plab oilalar ishsizlik tufayli qashshoqlikda yashamoqdalar.
cards.uzDef: Juda qashshoq, faqat yashash uchun yetarli pulga ega.

cards.ex: They live a hand-to-mouth existence, never knowing where their next meal will come from.
cards.exUz: Ular kun ko'rishadi, keyingi taomlari qayerdan kelishini hech qachon bilishmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Faqat o'sha kunlik ehtiyojlarni qondiradigan daromadga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: The company is flush with cash after the successful product launch.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya muvaffaqiyatli mahsulot ishga tushirilgandan so'ng pulga to'lib-toshgan.

cards.ex: She's really penny-pinching to save up for a house.
cards.exUz: U uy uchun pul yig'ish uchun juda tejamkorlik qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Juda tejamkor, har bir tiyinni hisoblash.

cards.ex: He seems to have money to burn, always buying expensive things.
cards.exUz: U keraksiz narsalarga sarflash uchun ko'p pulga ega ko'rinadi, doim qimmat narsalarni sotib oladi.
cards.uzDef: Keraksiz narsalarga sarflash uchun ko'p pulga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: His is a true rags to riches story; he started with nothing and became a millionaire.
cards.exUz: Uning hikoyasi haqiqiy qashshoqlikdan boylikka erishish hikoyasi; u hech narsadan boshlamadi va millioner bo'ldi.

cards.ex: I'm totally broke until payday.
cards.exUz: Oylikkacha pulim tugadi.

cards.ex: I can't go out tonight, I'm skint.
cards.exUz: Bugun kechqurun tashqariga chiqa olmayman, pulim yo'q.

cards.ex: We can get by on one salary, but it'll be tight.
cards.exUz: Biz bir oylik maosh bilan kun o'tkaza olamiz, lekin qiyin bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Yetarli pul bilan yashash, lekin boy bo'lmaslik.

cards.ex: I'm going to walk instead of taking the bus; a penny saved is a penny earned!
cards.exUz: Avtobusda yurish o'rniga piyoda yuraman; tejalgan pul — topilgan pul!
cards.term: penny saved is a penny earned
cards.uzDef: Pulni tejash pul topish bilan teng.

cards.ex: They managed to travel the world on a shoestring budget.
cards.exUz: Ular juda kam byudjet bilan dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qila olishdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda kam pul bilan ishlash yoki yashash.
